source_document: Lok Sabha Unstarred Question No. 775, Annexure-II: Estimates of Capacity Utilization (manufacturing sector) from Survey data (RBI's OBICUS)
source_role: official parliamentary compilation of RBI OBICUS observations
notes: The annexure states that the estimates are based on RBI OBICUS and are compiled at aggregate level.
The annexure explicitly warns that survey coverage varies by round and the estimates are indicative, not official statistics.
This acquisition preserves raw CU separately; CU-SA is not extracted from this source artifact because the annexure reports CU only.
